items.name: #1 Havana map
items.where: Map obtained: In a gutter in the south of Havana. Treasure: Havana, southern shore below a tower.
items.reward: Queen Anne's Figurehead Design Plan, 3000 Reales

items.name: #2 Havana Warehouse map
items.where: Map obtained: Loot the warehouse. Treasure: Anotto Bay: through an underwater tunnel past a broken diving bell, then a cave room with pirates and explosive barrels; dig in front of the middle barrel near the exit.

items.name: #3 Map of Shipwreck
items.where: Map obtained: From the Smelly Sailors event note at the docks. Treasure: Unmarked island northeast of Havana (named Dry Tortuga); two underwater chests mid-island, nothing to dig; the map stays in inventory.

items.name: #4 Cape Bonavista map
items.where: Map obtained: In a cave reached from a scaffold (page sentence is cut off). Treasure: Cape Bonavista: big cave entered from the south beach, at its end in a small puddle.

items.name: #5 Nassau Warehouse map
items.where: Map obtained: Loot the warehouse. Treasure: Isla Providencia: sand south of the southernmost viewpoint, below three palms.
items.gate: Isla Providencia unlocks after Sequence 08, Mission 03

items.name: #6 Andreas Island map
items.where: Map obtained: Southern shoreline, from a skeleton. Treasure: Abaco Island: between palms beside a large shipwreck.

items.name: #7 Abaco Island map
items.where: Map obtained: Southwest shore, from a skeleton leaning on a palm. Treasure: Salt Lagoon: sand in front of the tallest beach rock.

items.name: #8 Mariguana Island map
items.where: Map obtained: Small cave on the north approach; crawl through a tunnel hidden by leaves. Treasure: Andreas Island: small islet to the south.

items.name: #9 Great Inagua map
items.where: Map obtained: Climb trees on the beach to reach a cave. Treasure: Nassau: west edge of town, below a cliff jutting from the mountain.

items.name: #10 Treasure Map (Great Inagua Manor)
items.where: Map obtained: Reward for hanging all 11 character portraits in Great Inagua Manor. Treasure: Great Inagua: southern beach below a palm; reachable by ship or on foot.

items.name: #11 Salt Lagoon map
items.where: Map obtained: Northeast shore, from a skeleton. Treasure: New Bone: small islet to the north.

items.name: #12 Tortuga map
items.where: Map obtained: East shore, from a skeleton. Treasure: Matanzas: southeast corner, left of the Mayan stele behind a waterfall.

items.name: #13 Petite Caverne map
items.where: Map obtained: From a skeleton inside the cave. Treasure: Tulum: southernmost tip, on the beach behind a shipwreck.
items.reward: Fire Barrel Storage Ultimate Plan, 3000 Reales

items.name: #14 Cumberland Bay map
items.where: Map obtained: South shore, from a skeleton. Treasure: Pinos Isle: northwest corner of the viewpoint temple, in the grass.

items.name: #15 Cayman Sound map
items.where: Map obtained: On the beach, from a skeleton. Treasure: Petite Caverne: southern edge, behind rocks and a waterfall at the hutia spot.
items.reward: Heavy Shot Storage Ultimate Plan, 3000 Reales

items.name: #16 Pinos Isle map
items.where: Map obtained: Northern ruins, from a skeleton; enemies present. Treasure: Cayman Sound: northeast shore between palms.

items.name: #17 Santanillas map
items.where: Map obtained: Small hill, climb via branches. Treasure: San Juan: swim through the underwater tunnel into a cave, just before the wooden scaffold.
items.reward: Fire Barrel Strength Ultimate Plan, 3000 Reales

items.name: #18 Ambergris Key map
items.where: Map obtained: Underwater tunnel to a big room with a locked chest and enemies; climb pillars to the upper floor. Treasure: Misteriosa: behind the top level of the Mayan temple, left of a fountain, in grass behind white flowers.
items.reward: Heavy Shot Strength Ultimate Plan, 3000 Reales

items.name: #19 Corozal map
items.where: Map obtained: Small northeast islet, from a skeleton. Treasure: Ambergris Key: follow red jellyfish through the underwater tunnel and check the left corner inside.

items.name: #20 Misteriosa map
items.where: Map obtained: Below the viewpoint, from a skeleton in the ruins (climb down). Treasure: Kingston: small southeast beach between two broken boat pieces.

items.name: #21 Isla Providencia map
items.where: Map obtained: North beach, up a muddy path and a small brown trail between trees. Treasure: Long Bay: sand just south of three huts beside the viewpoint.
items.gate: Long Bay unlocks after Sequence 10, Mission 03

items.name: #22 Port Royal map
items.where: Map obtained: At a grave, from a skeleton. Treasure: Principe: southeast shore at a palm leaning over the water.
items.gate: Principe unlocks during or after Sequence 09, Mission 02

items.name: #23 Ile a Vache map
items.where: Map obtained: Northeast shore, from a skeleton. Treasure: Jiguey: inside the cave's pirate section, swim to the beach with a brute; sand on the right between palms.

items.name: #24 Kingston Warehouse map
items.where: Map obtained: Loot the warehouse in the southwest. Treasure: Cumberland Bay: sand beside an interactive rowboat.

items.name: #25 Blackbeard's Treasure Map
items.where: Map obtained: Given automatically by the cutscene ending Sequence 08, Mission 01. Treasure: Anotto Bay (quest Blackbeard's Treasure): blow two walls past pirate rooms with explosive barrels; treasure is behind the second wall. Turn it in at the chest on Great Inagua.

items.name: #26 Restored Weathered Map
items.where: Map obtained: Treasure dealer (available from Sequence 4). Treasure: Mystery Island, eastern half: in a round rock formation beside a haystack.
items.gate: 6 Weathered Pieces + 350 Tobacco; pieces are in chests in five caves (keys from pirate leaders), one is bought from the dealer

items.name: #27 Restored Yellowed Map
items.where: Map obtained: Treasure dealer (from Sequence 4). Treasure: Black Island: northeast shore, sand beside a shipwreck.
items.gate: 10 Yellowed Pieces + 100 Aloe; pieces are random Kenway's Fleet schooner rewards
items.reward: Obsidian Sails; The Wellerman (shanty); Helm of the Night Owl

items.name: #28 Restored Digested Map
items.where: Map obtained: Treasure dealer (from Sequence 4). Treasure: Santanillas: cave under the southern temple, entered from the beach or a well to the south.
items.gate: 2 Digested Pieces + 200 Rum; pieces drop from the White Jaguar on Great Inagua (slow respawn); rum from Gibara ships

items.name: #29 Restored Tattered Map
items.where: Map obtained: Treasure dealer (from Sequence 4). Treasure: Florida: northern tip, sand below three palms.
items.gate: 3 Tattered Pieces + 200 Sugar; pieces from captain's lockboxes on Frigate/Man-o-War hunters (wanted level 3-4); sugar from Gibara ships
items.reward: Elite Wheel; Gilt Lined Sails; Sleek Crew Attire

items.name: #30 Restored Preserved Map
items.where: Map obtained: Treasure dealer (from Sequence 4). Treasure: Sacrifice Island: southwest shore, sand under a rock arch.
items.gate: 4 Preserved Pieces + 150 Tobacco; pieces from looting the 9 warehouses on a second visit (2-hour cooldown)
items.reward: Shade and Shadow Robes; Wooden Eyeball

gaps: Entry 4: page sentence on where the map is found is cut off mid-phrase.
notes: Each item's region field is where the map is obtained; the buried-treasure location is inside 'where'. The page names each map by inventory name and buried-at name; item names here are short labels from the obtained-at name. Dealer maps 26-30 are made at the Great Inagua docks treasure dealer.
